classification.evidence: E ≈ N: six components carry six relations along one shallow chain (cli -> api -> {auth, queue} -> worker -> db), the source asks for slow sparse traffic on it, and there is no bus, no fan of three around a core and no identifier/qualifier content.
tie_breakers_considered: Density: E == N (6/6) so it is a chain, not a mesh or a fabric — no fan of 2-3 edges around a core and no double-arrowhead targets.
Bus with disconnected worlds: none; the graph is weakly connected, so not placement-planes.
Identifier/qualifier content: none (no addresses, ports, AS numbers, historical or unconfirmed facts), so not identity-probe-maps.
Motion is a signature, not a tie-breaker: one dot per line here, but the fan is depth-2 (api has two out-edges), not the 5-wide phase fan of a lifecycle machine.
classification.secondary_recipe_borrowed: lifecycle-machines: 'every live transition carries exactly one dot' — all six relations are live traffic, so all six carry one dot and none is left static.
